The protocol, previously shown to eliminate information leakage to an eavesdropper in a pure-loss channel and minimize leakage in a noisy channel, is extended to scenarios where the channel transmissivity fluctuates, as in atmospheric turbulence. The authors evaluate the secret key rate performance under fading conditions and compare it with comparable protocols.
